name: EPIC 212333310

text.card: A red giant 3,181 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.88 solar masses and 8.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,784 K at its surface.
